name: AirFit
tagline: Sit-up soft-shell hyperbaric chamber, up to 1.5 ATA.
description: The OneBase AirFit is the most flexible chamber in the range: sit up to read or work, or lie back and recover. Adjustable pressure up to 1.5 ATA, a compact footprint, and an internal frame that keeps the chamber's shape between sessions.

sizes.label: Mini
sizes.note: Compact — for apartments and smaller rooms. 170 cm long.

sizes.label: Plus
sizes.note: Room to sit up or lie flat. 220 cm long.

highlights.title: Built to last
highlights.body: Triple-zip closure and a protective outer cover, with an internal metal frame that holds the chamber's structure even when deflated.

highlights.title: See out, breathe easy
highlights.body: Four transparent viewing windows, a recline seat and mattress, and an internal pressure gauge so you always know where you are in the session.

highlights.title: Clean air, fast exit
highlights.body: Oil-free compressor filters air to 0.001 microns. A rapid-response emergency depressurisation valve is always within reach.

highlights.title: Oxygen on demand
highlights.body: Optional oxygen delivery under pressure via face mask or nasal cannula.

faqs.q: Are all hyperbaric chambers the same?
faqs.a: No. The main differences are pressure, size and construction material. Soft-shell chambers typically run 1.3–1.5 ATA; hard-shell chambers reach around 2.0 ATA.

faqs.q: How often should I do HBOT?
faqs.a: Most clients see the best results on a protocol of five sessions per week. For maintenance or targeted goals such as recovery or mental clarity, the OneBase app tells you when and for how long.
